name: Quizaften med Henrik Milling | Kulturhuset Islands Brygge
description:
Kom og test dig selv og din viden når Henrik Milling hiver dig og dine venner igennem en popkulturel tour de force af en quiz i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge.

En quiz om alle vores skønne fælles oplevelser indenfor film, tv, radio, musik, nyheder og alt det andet der har fyldt mediebilledet gennem de sidste 30 - 40 år.

Har du styr på Back to the future, Matador, Friends, Familien på Bryggen, Polle fra Snave, Backstreet Boys, Bowie, Afrikas Stjerne, Eurovision Song Contest, Den Store Bagedyst, Harry Potter og alt under over og imellem?

Så forvent at blive skiftevis henrykt og udfordret i denne hvirvelvind af stjernestunder fra det danske mediebillede gennem tiderne.

Med andre ord: En quiz i cinemascope med 3-D stereo expansion pack

Quizmaster: Henrik Milling

Henrik Milling er kendt fra radioprogrammer som f.eks FONK - det er Lørdag på P4, er en af DRs mest brugte musik og kultureksperter, og har været kommentator på Eurovision Song Contest gennem de sidste par år.

Vigtigt:

Hvert hold må max have 6 deltagere!
Billetprisen er pr deltager, ikke pr hold.
Quizzen afvikles naturligvis uden brug af mobiltelefoner.
Kom evt. i god tid i forvejen og hent noget mad i cafeen som opvarmning. Vi åbner dørene kl 18 til salen, så man kan spise med sit hold.
Og! - Cafeen er naturligvis åben så man kan hente fadbamser og skarphedskaffe o.l. når der er pauser

name: GUZO // Radar
description:
I foråret 2025 tager GUZO på sin første turné for at bringe sin debut-ep "Caravan" til live i Danmarks tre største byer, og du kan opleve ham på Radar.
______________

DØRE: 19.00
KONCERT: 20.00
ENTRÉ: 175,-
______________

GUZO har hittet stort i 2024 med sange som den tidligere P3’s Uundgåelige “Still”, RnB-bangeren “Eat Sleep Repeat” og senest guitar-balladen “Keep Forgetting”. Lyden er en blanding af folk, country, R’n’b og alternativ pop. GUZO balancerer denne blanding af forskellige inspirationer med inderlighed og kunstnerisk integritet som ledestjerne og udgiver sin musik gennem sit eget pladeselskab Big Dog Records.

GUZO’s talent for sangskrivning og historiefortælling har gjort ham til en af landets mest eftertragtede sangskrivere. Han har blandt andet skrevet sange for Jada, Andreas Odbjerg, Phlake og SAVEUS, Artigeardit, Goss og Clara.

Lyden af GUZO er en bastard mellem Bon Iver, 070 Shake og 90-grunge. Universet er lige så kontrastfyldt, som det er særegent. Debutsingle “RADICAL”, er et godt eksempel på det rå univers. Sangen er en medrivende og hårdtslående midnats-hymne til det vilde og det ufiltrerede. 

Du kan forvente en oplevelse, der går lige i hjertet, når GUZO og hans band indtager Radars scene. 

VI glæder os til at se dig <3

name: QUEER BEE X EVIN (DE)
description:
QUEER BEE is the Rave in the Cave you Won't miss.
This night is a celebration of diversity, love, and self-expression. Embrace your true self or don a dazzling alter ego. The dress code? Anything that makes you feel fierce, fabulous, and free. Gender norms are so last season.

Let the beats guide you through a sonic journey curated by the most eclectic DJs from the queer community.


Evin:
Berlin-based DJ and co-founder of Dimenzione Danza, evin is carving a name for herself in Europe’s vibrant club scene, by fusing her Kurdish heritage with electrifying, untamed energy on the decks. 

Her sets are genre-fluid, cutting influences across euphoric house, punchy electro, and progressive trance, with a forward-thinking vision. High-energy and full of groove, her performances defy genres and bring a unity to the dance floor, making each set a shared journey of pure, infectious energy. There’s an intoxicating pull to evin’s sound – seductive basslines, percussive rhythms, and driving melodies collide to transform the club into a sonic sanctuary, a space of uninhibited movement, collective euphoria and unhinged fun.

name: Coven [US]
description:
Hengivne af legendariske Jinx Dawson og Coven kan glæde sig, da ypperstepræstinden for alt, hvad der er uhelligt, vender tilbage til København når de spiller Stengade d. 17 april til en aften af med kulksort wicked occult rock. 

Coven:
Coven is an American psychedelic occult rock band, composed of vocalist Jinx Dawson, bassist Oz Osborne and drummer Steve Ross. They had a top 10 hit on Warner Brothers Records with a cover of Original Caste's "One Tin Soldier", which was used as the theme song to the 1971 movie Billy Jack.

Jinx Dawson, Ross, and Osborne formed Coven in Chicago in the late 1960s. They were signed to Mercury Records, where they put out their first album, Witchcraft Destroys Minds and Reaps Souls in 1969. The music on the album was, for the most part, standard pop psychedelia; what made it distinctive was the heavy emphasis on diabolical subject matter, including songs such as "The White Witch of Rose Hall", "For Unlawful Carnal Knowledge", and "Dignitaries of Hell". The album concluded with a 13 minute track of chanting and Satanic prayers called "Satanic Mass".
Unwanted publicity came to the band in the form of a sensational Esquire magazine article entitled "Evil Lurks in California," which linked counterculture interest in the occult to Charles Manson and the Tate-La Bianca murders. As a result, Mercury withdrew the album from circulation.

Coven released a self-titled album in 1972 which featured "One Tin Soldier" along with "Nightengale," penned by Jinx Dawson, which charted as a hot pic on Billboard & Cashbox. A third album, Blood on the Snow, was put out on Buddah Records in 1974.One of the 1st music videos ever made directly for an album title song was produced by Jinx and the Coven with Disney Studios. In 1990 Coven appeared in the film "Heaven Can Help" with Jinx in a starring role. She wrote all the music and along with original drummer Steve Ross, new members were added to the Coven which appeared in the film.

name: Denham Audio (UK), Parashoot, Mary Harp
description:
The young DJ, Producer, Label Head, and Party Starter Franck is here for a party and he's not messing In a blizzard of breakbeats, b-lines and acid hooks, Denham Audio has brought new urgency and vitality to the modern rave scene. The sound he’s pushing is rooted in the legacy of UK hardcore, but those foundational sounds and styles are given a thorough spruce up, feeding into the buoyant areas of exploration happening between 140 and 160 BPM. 
Releases have been coming thick and fast, from early outings on Nineteen Ninety Four and Artifice through to a blistering run on WNCL, Frendzone! (alongside Violet), Lobster Theremin, Sneaker Social Club and more. Across these 12”s you can hear every shred of influence spilling out – from the upfront hardcore and jungle through to hip hop and reggae, and beyond the confines of music into sci-fi and anime. 
As well as a relentless charge of rave-ready EPs and DJ sets spanning the UK and as far as Seoul, Tokyo, Berlin, New York and elsewhere, the Denham Audio pressure also piles into the Club Glow collective. Alongside Borai, LMajor and Mani Festo, Denham is presenting a communal front which first manifested as a tape series and now spans 12” drops, a monthly session on Balamii Radio and coordinated blitzes on appropriately sized dancehalls. It’s a natural extension of Denham’s production endeavours, succinctly captured on the SNKRX05 12” as “16v hatchback breakbeat NRG kickin’ it out of your Kenwood system.” We couldn’t have put it better ourselves.

name: NEW GAME+ : Marco Leckbert (ES) / Anastasia Terra (UA) / Kardinal Bertram / Only Ollie / Nat
description:
New Game+ is a gaming themed club night curated and hosted by Kardinal Bertram. In Gaming terminology, a "New Game+" is a game mode that allows the player to replay a game, while keeping items and or experience gained in the first playthrough. All that is left to do now is for you to equip your favorite gear and get ready to level up with us once again!

Main floor is a showcase of the harder shades of techno: Ranging from intricate hypnotic bangers to Industrial techno, Schranz and Hard Techno.
The Kiosk floor will be taking you on a lower paced yet powerful, hypnotic and melodic Side Quest.

Our main character for this Easter DLC is a Spanish grandmaster of Schranz - Marco Leckbert. Prepare yourself for an action packed playthrough with rolling percussions, emotional melodics and thundering kicks & basslines!


BONUS XP for gaming themed outfits, but this is not mandatory.
